observations.observation: The Executive Yuan archive lists Cho’s oral policy report to the 11th Legislature’s sixth session as dated September 29, 2026. The official PDF is the earliest primary-source record located, but the retrieved text extract did not show the particular three-continent passage.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The date is documented, but the report’s exact relevant wording and any facility-level details were not verified from the extracted PDF passage.

observations.observation: DigiTimes’ September 30 lead attributes to Cho a description of Taiwan’s semiconductor industry as having expanded from Hsinchu through the Central and Southern Taiwan science parks to manufacturing bases on three continents. The page shows publication at 09:04Z and update at 09:06Z, before cutoff.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: Only the headline and lead were accessible. The claim gives no named countries, facilities, capacity, schedule, or company-specific details; the headline’s R&D framing is not enough to establish the status of any particular R&D site.

observations.observation: UDN contemporaneously reported Cho’s policy report to the Legislature on September 29, independently corroborating the public delivery and setting but not the specific three-continent statement.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The retrieved report focused on the legislative session and Cho’s requests to lawmakers, not the semiconductor-footprint wording; its revision status is unknown.

observations.observation: Prior public context included a September 10 government plan for domestic semiconductor facilities and R&D-related infrastructure, as well as a September 26 report on TSMC’s Arizona expansion plan. Inference: global manufacturing presence and continued Taiwan-based R&D policy can coexist; the broad statement alone does not establish a new operational milestone.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The government plan and TSMC investment plan are contextual facts; the retrieved material does not demonstrate completed projects, the identity of all three continents, or a change in Micron’s operations.

gaps: The relevant paragraph in the September 29 primary report was not exposed in the retrieved PDF text; exact original wording and any named locations remain unverified.
